title: SYSTEMS DYNAMICS AND CONTROL
description: Models and analyzes linear continuous systems in time and frequency domains. Introduces fundamentals of single-input-single-output control system design. CROSSLISTED as ECE 356/ME 320.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (ME 217, 317 or 317H) or (ECE 351 and 352 and (ENGR 212 or 212H)).
A minimum grade of C is required in ME 217, ME 317, ME 317H, ECE 351, ECE 352, ENGR 212 and ENGR 212H.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering college.
meeting_html: MW 2pm-3:50pm in WLKN 110 - Gilfillan Auditorium (Wilkinson Hall) (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
